title: Wretched Brats
subtitle: They need to be punished. Of course, the penalties shall be kept within both ethical and legal boundaries.

trails.title: The Opportunist and The Sticky Gum

content.text: Now those little brats are knocked out. You noticed that old gum sticking to the bottom of their shoes, like crushed leeches.

branch.text: Having been chewed for long, it took on the light amber color that the carbohydrate gum should have. Some folds were cyan. It's most likely mint-flavored.

The sales champion of mint gum is the bubble gum machine near Wrigley Field. When a crazy game ends, there's always someone who needs something to chew in the mouth in order to take out the anger over the defeat.
But ... Hey. Haven't you noticed yet? That wonderful mix of particles in the chewing gum base that's been squeezed into lumps?
The off-white sand. The synthetic waxed elastic fiber. In the South Bank, there is only one place where such a politically symbolic floor is laid—St. Pavlov Foundation.
Tragedy. A sympathetic encounter. It has fulfilled its mission cautiously and conscientiously. But clearly, no one cares.
I dare say it's the most popular mint gum now. When the Chicagoans lost their rights to get drunk, they could only turn to this nasty upstart stuff.
The sales champion is the bubble gum machine near Wrigley Field. The old gum on the kids' soles also comes from there.

Some gravel mixed into the squeezed gum base. The off-white sand. The synthetic waxed elastic fiber. In the South Bank, there is only one place where such a politically symbolic floor is laid—St. Pavlov Foundation.
Who does? I'm very glad that we are on the same page on this.
Describing an abandoned carbohydrate gum won't give anyone pleasure. So, let's skip to the next subject—Have you noticed the gravel mixed into the gum base?
The off-white sand. The synthetic waxed elastic fiber. In the South Bank, there is only one place where such a politically symbolic floor is laid—St. Pavlov Foundation.

content.text: It's very lively here in the square, just like every day in the past. Speculators, who advocate mankind supremacy, are trying to get the attention of the Foundation through demonstrations.

They are on the same side as the Foundation, but the Foundation has no intention to treat these protesters as allies and give them what they want. They even sent a little girl to go through the motions as a perfunctory response.

branch.text: Yes. Yes. No one will ever ignore them. They are honey-colored. They are the morning sun in California. They are the dazzling spot on the doe that you'll never catch.
For those hypocritical politicians, the little girls are the delicacies that they would drool over. Luckily, this little girl is not one of their prey.
She is nervous but not panicked. She doesn't seem to be good at dealing with these slick "politicians." The mission capsule of the Foundation grew hot in her tightly clutched fist.
And on the other side of the square, another little girl in a black suit is looking over here gloomily. She stood by the Foundation's air outlet, the best place for her.
The position that is too marginal to be further marginalized. That's the best portrayal of the second-generation immigrants in the 20th century.

content.text: Tell me about that Foundation girl.

branch.text: She is the good girl you already know. Orange hair. When she's deep in thought, she turns her pen like a nimble ball in a magician's hand.
She is puzzled at the guys shouting around her. But there's light in her eyes, as if she's expecting something nice.
Is it because of the next task packed in the mission capsule? Or the people she is going to meet?
Her cheeks are a little rosy now. The thing in her hands was loosened too.

content.text: Who's the girl in a black suit?

branch.text: She's someone you will know in the future.
Now she shudders and shivers, like a cricket desperate for shelter. She's looking for an eave or a piece of rubble in the "Storm."
Her figure might be frail, but her eyes are filled with cold anger. Maybe she had been rejected just now, or even insulted. She walked up to the square center with firm step, like a warrior.
She had to perform another task she didn't like.
At this moment, the capsule in the hand of the ad hoc representative of the Foundation dropped under the push of the crowd.

content.text: She feels a hot wind from Africa blow towards Trapani. Then, the whole of Sicily becomes dry, warm, and comes alive. The air smells like tropical corals and wild oranges.
That wind is never supposed to be part of this cold winter. But the warm vibe lingering and dancing in her mind reminds her to live on.
Though all she has been through was failure after failure, her vigorous vitality won't fade away, at least not now.

items.text: In Our Time
Wretched Brats

items.speaker: Little Giant Tommy
items.text: P-p-people come out from the suitcase?!

items.speaker: Pumpkin-Head Jame
items.text: Agh, it's a weirdo's case! She knows dark magic. Run!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is my suitcase. Please give it back to me.

items.speaker: Little Giant Tommy
items.text: No! Don't touch me! Imma give it to the officer!

items.speaker: Pumpkin-Head Jame
items.text: Haha! Kiss my ass! You damn Basilisk losers!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: ... When a pirate meets robbers? Robbing is not a good behavior that you kids should learn.

items.speaker: Pumpkin-Head Jame
items.text: That apple is talking!

items.speaker: Pumpkin-Head Jame
items.text: Ew!! Throw rocks at it!!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Aww ...!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Looks like the generation we met is not quite friendly.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: If they shake the suitcase like this, Regulus will probably fall apart.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Mr. APPLe, I need your help.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: My pleasure. This APPLe will shed some light on justice for them—well, won't violate the Declaration of the Rights of the Child.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hide it in the tree hole this time. It shouldn't be that easy to be found.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The situation of the arcanists 40 years ago looked much worse than ours. At least we can still talk to the human.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The subculture movement has indeed changed the social status of some arcanists. While in the 1920s ... there are still many injustices.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Mr. APPLe, how long will it take for the suitcase to be completely invisible?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Thirty minutes. This APPLe is still waiting for the right solar altitude.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: You can meet with Regulus first. This APPLe is afraid that in order to have some fun, she might ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ahem ... In order to relieve the boredom, she might make you troubles.
Okay.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Okay.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Regulus?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There is only echo.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And no sign of Regulus.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No one's here. The light is off. Did she go to another room?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Someone is singing at the lake. The sound carries into the room faintly.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Haha ... ♪

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Regulus! Why are you there?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The outside scenery keeps changing and changing …

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What has remained unchanged for ages is the lake and an old spinning wheel.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: *sobs* ... The records ... Don't nick my records …

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Her voice doesn't sound right.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I should go and take a look.

segments.internal_title: 第一章1-1.3（新手引导湖泊场景）

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is where Vertin has never been.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Regulus! Regulus!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I can't see her at all ... The fog is getting thicker …

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Vertin goes closer and finds half a spinning wheel in the middle of the lake, with strange threads on it.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... The line is two-dimensional?
The water rises.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: More and more water rises.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The ground is covered with rainwater from the "Storm." Incredibly, the water has no weight, or humidity. It just flows slowly and quietly, like time.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Time ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I seem to have seen this ... It's ... I …

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The line in her hand, technically the line-like thing in her hand which cannot be felt in any way, has gradually formed a path in her sight.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And someone is going to be invited over.

segments.internal_title: 第一章1-1.4（新手引导湖泊场景）

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... Timekeeper?! Yes! Ahh, ahem, I ... I'm just thinking about how to find you.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: May I ask where is this place?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Did you use the advanced arcane skill "Aferoj Around," No. 000262603100008, to send me over?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: No, it should not be this ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto?! Why are ... Is it because I touched ... that line?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: While Sonetto is immersed in the joy of the reunion, someone is snoring nearby.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: *grunting*

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The fog lifts and reveals Regulus. Now, she is sleeping soundly with a rock in her arms.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Regulus?!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Madam Z is right! She said Regulus was with you!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What?!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Regulus, she ... Hmm? She seems to be asleep ... well ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Umm ... I am also a bit like ... quite dizzy ...?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Why did you all black out?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What happened? I don't seem to be affected ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: On the lake, the spinning wheel is still shimmering.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hmm ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I should come back and check again later.
Take them away first.
The sound of water is left behind her.
TO BE CONTINUED…
